en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a river with a cart and person in the shallow water in the foreground, ducks on the river, and a town along the riverbanks. On the left there is a bridge and riverside buildings; in the middle distance a crowd of people stands along the right bank. On the hill in the background stands a prominent fortress or castle. Handwritten text in Greek runs around the margins. At the bottom, the place name appears in Latin characters.
